dedupe_keys.name: urbanwaste urban metabolism data waste tourism and socio economic indicators for 11 european tourist city pilots 2000 2015

description: This workbook shows how waste generation in popular European tourist destinations rises and falls with visitor numbers, a pressure that waste services must plan for each season. The producers are Iris Gruber, Roland Ramusch and Gudrun Obersteiner of the Institute of Waste Management at the University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences, Vienna, who collected it from partners in the Horizon 2020 URBANWASTE project. Coverage is 11 pilot areas: Copenhagen, Dubrovnik, Florence, Kavala, Lisbon, Nice, Nicosia, Ponta Delgada, Santander, Syracuse and three municipalities on Tenerife. For each pilot it gives waste quantities and management, tourist accommodation, arrivals, overnight stays and tourism economy, and socio-economic context, annually from 2000 to 2015 and monthly for 2013 to 2015 for selected series, with the source and spatial scale of each figure. It is available as a free download from Zenodo under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: gaps where local data did not exist, some series only at regional or national scale, and definitions that differ between cities. Simulation uses: modelling seasonal peaks in waste collection demand and sizing services for tourist populations. Related records: the Eurostat municipal waste statistics (data-eurostat-env-wasmun) give national comparators.
name: URBANWASTE urban metabolism data: waste, tourism and socio-economic indicators for 11 European tourist city pilots (2000-2015)
provider: Iris Gruber, Roland Ramusch and Gudrun Obersteiner (Institute of Waste Management, University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences, Vienna), URBANWASTE project
schema_summary: Workbook with authors and definitions sheets and one sheet per pilot (Copenhagen, Dubrovnik, Florence, Kavala, Lisbon, Nice, Nicosia, Ponta Delgada, Santander, Syracuse, and Adeje, Arona and Puerto de la Cruz on Tenerife) covering waste generation and management, tourism (accommodation capacity, arrivals, overnight stays, tourism economy) and socio-economic data, with source and spatial scale for each series

spatial_resolution: City, municipality or metropolitan area (some series regional or national)
